source.name: Level 5 1.3 Test Your Knowledge - EnterpriseSearchPolicy documents
source.instructions: Where does `EnterpriseSearchPolicy` look for documents to index, and when does it build the index?

answers.answer: It reads from `domain/*.yml` at train time
It reads `.txt` files from `docs/` at train time

source.guidance: The index is built during `rasa train` from `.txt` files in `docs/`. Changes to your knowledge base have no effect until you retrain, because the agent searches the index on disk, not the raw files. The index is loaded into memory when the agent starts.
